description: This file implements MQTT client functionality for a device, including connection management, subscription handling, message queueing, error handling, and interaction with the mosquitto library. It manages multiple MQTT clients, handles their states, and supports features like SSL/TLS, MQTT v5, and dynamic control of connect/disconnect actions.

classes.name: mqtt_client_t
classes.description: Represents an individual MQTT client connection, maintaining connection parameters, state, subscriptions, message queues, SSL context, and related metadata.

classes.name: mqtt_send_item_t
classes.description: Represents a message queued for sending over MQTT, including topic, QoS, message ID, and expiry details.
